author: Praxis II
title: Auto‑GHS DAQB v2: Two subsamples + ε tie‑break toward (λ=0.7, δ=0.15, k_density=20)
abstract: We improve the label‑free Auto‑GHS tuner by averaging the Graph Health Score (GHS) over two independent batch‑stratified subsamples, then applying an ε=0.01 tie‑break toward the proven default (λ=0.7, δ=0.15, k_density=20). This reduces variance in candidate selection while retaining label‑free operation. Final graph is rebuilt on full data; edges are binary with true distances.
